How many light-years away is the Andromeda Galaxy?

What is the name of the radiation that was first detected in the 1960s and serves as evidence of the Big Bang?
What is the approximate limit, in years, that we can look back into the past based on current observations?

youtube_description:
Unveiling the Cosmos: A 13.8 Billion Year Odyssey
Imagine a time machine made of light! In this incredible journey, we embark on a 13.8 billion year adventure through cosmic history. Light, with its ultimate speed limit, becomes our guide, revealing the universe as it unfolded over aeons. By deciphering the faint whispers of the Big Bang's afterglow and the light from galaxies far, far away, we can reconstruct the grand story of the cosmos. We travel back to the very first tick of existence, witnessing the birth of stars and galaxies. We then zoom forward, observing the emergence of life and the universe's relentless expansion. This is a breathtaking exploration of our universe's incredible evolution.
